## Overview {#overview}

Students build and evaluate a robot whose learned policy proposes each action and
whose independent governor decides whether to permit it. Measurements of the
resulting motion inform the next decision. The course is a proposed hardware
studio and has not yet been taught.

## Syllabus and schedule {#syllabus}

The [ETH Zurich spring 2027 syllabus](eth-spring-2027/syllabus.qmd) is the
current draft plan. Another offering would set its own dates, equipment, and
policies.

## For instructors {#for-instructors}

The [instructor syllabus](https://mlsysbook.ai/instructors/vol4/) lists the
readings, the robot station, and the checks staff must complete before students
use it.

## Offerings {#offerings}

- [**ETH Zurich · Spring 2027**](eth-spring-2027/index.qmd): project seminar and
  hardware studio taught by Vijay Janapa Reddi, with teaching assistant Andrea
  Mattia Garavagno.
- [**Autonomous Machines · Harvard CS249r · Fall 2019**](https://brianplancher.com/courses/cs249r_autonomous/){#earlier-related-courses}:
  an earlier related course on autonomous vehicles, drones, and robots, with its
  [syllabus](https://brianplancher.com/files/CS249_F19_Syllabus.pdf),
  [paper list](https://brianplancher.com/files/CS249_F19_Papers.pdf), and
  [slides](https://brianplancher.com/files/CS249_F19_IntroSlides.pdf). It predates
  the current textbook.
